opening.argument: The material explains how to recruit and place new members within Mirror Trading International's left or right team leg. Viewers are shown that sending a registration link places a person in the sender's weaker leg, while the system provides automatic, left, or right placement options. It also instructs viewers to copy the link and send it to prospects, and explains that specific placement links may be distributed as the team grows. That is an instructional explanation of a referral and team-placement system, supported by visible registration options and a branching team diagram, without a deceptive promise, required payment, claimed financial return, or request for sensitive data. It therefore presents operational guidance rather than a concrete fraudulent solicitation.

citations.quote: When you send someone your registration link, the system will place the person in your weaker leg.
